text: Codebook source truth inst/extdata/codebook.csv defines 47 variables : - variable — canonical snake_case name used throughout package - nces_var — original NCES uppercase name raw data (e.g. COUNTYCD) - survey — survey variable belongs - level — "" variables shared across surveys (unitid, geoid) - era_notes — documents known schema breaks across vintages - alignment_notes — joins/crosswalks datasets Critical: unitid geoid level = "", causes apply_codebook_mapping() rename surveys (just IC). Without , geo joins completions grad_rates silently fail. Era reconciliation layer reconcile_vintage() sits raw parquet codebook renaming. Era fixes survey: IC: - 2024+: C00CARNEGIE → CARNEGIE (NCES renamed column) - : sentinel codes (-1, -2, -3) → NA - : UNITID zero-padded 6 digits - : COUNTYCD zero-padded 5 digits (sentinel removal) - : geo columns added NA absent (guard pre-2009 attempts) Completions: - : sentinel → NA, UNITID pad - : race/demographic columns added NA absent (schema evolution) - Warns pre-2009 doctoral AWLEVEL codes (9/10/11) appear Grad rates: - : sentinel → NA, UNITID pad, race columns padded Grad rate GRTYPE structure (important) GRTYPE (mapped cohort_type) uniquely identifies row’s role: - GRTYPE 1 = starting cohort (used county aggregation) - GRTYPE 2 = adjusted cohort denominator - GRTYPE 3 = completers within 150% normal time numerator → grad_rate_150pct - GRTYPE 4 = transfer-students numerator → transfer_out_rate - GRTYPE ≥ 6 = sections (part-time, transfer-, etc.) — excluded County aggregation filters directly GRTYPE values 2/3/4, CHRTSTAT. County variables (16 total) IC survey (7 counts): inst_count, public_inst_count, nonprofit_inst_count, fouryear_inst_count, twoyear_inst_count, hbcu_count, tribal_count Completions survey (7): count_degrees_total (raw count, agg_var=NA), share_degrees_assoc/bach/masters/doctoral/men/women (proportions, agg_var=total) Grad rates survey (2): grad_rate_150pct, transfer_out_rate (proportions, agg_var=NA) county aggregations restricted degree-granting institutions (is_degree_granting == 1) valid geoid. Excluded sectors: 0, 99. Tracked degree levels: AWLEVEL codes 2, 3 (associate’s), 5 (bachelor’s), 7 (master’s), 17, 18, 19 (doctoral). Excludes certificates undocumented codes. four level shares use universe → shares sum exactly 1.
